title: Test Setup Fixtures
author: theasianpianist
body: Create fixtures for common setup/teardown actions including setting the upper ToR to active.

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: We have a fixture ```rand_one_dut_hostname``` already, which select a tor randomly. Do we need to set the selected tor as active?

comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body: The tests are written with the assumption that the upper ToR always starts as the active ToR, so picking a ToR randomly may not work. My thought was simply to add a dual-tor specific conftest and add an auto-used fixture which calls `toggle_all_simulator_ports_to_tor_a`

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: I have a PR which pre selects a DUT (say upper TOR). If we need to set ToR_A as active, the PR will be a solution. But it's a huge change, which need a lot verification.

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: I created a PR #2850 to set the randomly selected ToR as active.
